#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Restore GEN3C environment from Drive cache.
# Usage on Colab worker: bash /content/drive/MyDrive/koi_waymo2pano_colab/cache/t11_gen3c/restore.sh
set -eo pipefail
CACHE=/content/drive/MyDrive/koi_waymo2pano_colab/cache/t11_gen3c
echo "[restore] start $(date -u)"
# 1. miniconda (if missing)
if [ ! -d $HOME/miniconda3 ]; then
  echo '[restore] installing miniconda...'
  wget -q https://repo.anaconda.com/miniconda/Miniconda3-py310_24.9.2-0-Linux-x86_64.sh -O /tmp/mc.sh
  bash /tmp/mc.sh -b -p $HOME/miniconda3
fi
source $HOME/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
# 2. untar conda env
if [ ! -d $HOME/miniconda3/envs/cosmos-predict1 ]; then
  echo '[restore] untar cosmos-predict1 env...'
  mkdir -p $HOME/miniconda3/envs
  zstd -d -c $CACHE/cosmos-predict1.env.tar.zst | tar -xf - -C $HOME/miniconda3/envs/
fi
# 3. untar GEN3C
if [ ! -d /content/GEN3C ]; then
  echo '[restore] untar GEN3C...'
  zstd -d -c $CACHE/GEN3C.tar.zst | tar -xf - -C /content/
fi
# 4. untar Pi3 (optional)
if [ -f $CACHE/Pi3.tar.zst ] && [ ! -d /content/Pi3 ]; then
  echo '[restore] untar Pi3...'
  zstd -d -c $CACHE/Pi3.tar.zst | tar -xf - -C /content/
fi
echo '[restore] activating env to verify...'
set +u; conda activate cosmos-predict1; set -u
python --version
echo "[restore] done $(date -u)"
RESTORE_EOF
chmod +x "$CACHE_DIR/restore.sh"; echo '---write manifest---'; python -c "
import json, os, time, subprocess
def sz(p):
    return round(os.path.getsize(p) / 1e9, 3) if os.path.exists(p) else 0
manifest = {
    'created_utc': time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime()),
    'env_tarball': '$CACHE_DIR/cosmos-predict1.env.tar.zst',
    'env_tarball_gb': sz('$CACHE_DIR/cosmos-predict1.env.tar.zst'),
    'gen3c_tarball': '$CACHE_DIR/GEN3C.tar.zst',
    'gen3c_tarball_gb': sz('$CACHE_DIR/GEN3C.tar.zst'),
    'pi3_tarball': '$CACHE_DIR/Pi3.tar.zst' if os.path.exists('$CACHE_DIR/Pi3.tar.zst') else None,
    'pi3_tarball_gb': sz('$CACHE_DIR/Pi3.tar.zst'),
    'restore_script': '$CACHE_DIR/restore.sh',
    'env_size_uncompressed_gb': $ENV_SIZE_GB,
    'tar_wall_seconds': $((t1-t0)),
    'note': 'Restore on a fresh Colab session via: bash $CACHE_DIR/restore.sh. Saves ~50 min vs full reinstall.'
}
print(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2))
open('$CACHE_DIR/cache_done_v1.json','w').write(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2))
" 2>&1 | tail -20; df -h /content/drive 2>&1 | head -3; ls -lah "$CACHE_DIR"; echo "[t11-tar-cache] done $(date -u)"
